Pairing your braided rug with a rug pad is the best way to get long-lasting results. We recommend a thin open-weave or felt-plus-rubber rug pad under any braided rug placed on hardwood, tile, laminate, or vinyl floors. A pad provides extra traction to prevent slipping, keeps the rug smooth and flat, adds cushioning, and protects both your flooring and the rug's backing to extend its life.
